t: A 45 minute lesson to remix songs with code blocks and an AI beat helper.
steps: Open the Jam Session lesson on Code.org in a browser with sound.
Check that the school allows Code.org.
Decide whether students will sign in.
Try the lesson yourself and play with the AI Beat block.
Read the lesson plan note on the temperature setting.
Share the lesson link with students.
Give students headphones for the music.
